Description:
  Network speed tester including server discovery, latency measurement, download and upload speed testing.

Usage:
  netpace [command] [options]

Options:
  -v, --version                                      Prints version information.
  --loop                                             Performs the speed test on continuous loop.
  --count <count>                                    Stop speed testing after this many times. [default: 1]
  --delay <delay>                                    Time between multiple speed tests (HH:MM:SS). [default: 00:00:00]
  --time-limit <time-limit>                          Stop a speed test run after this long (HH:MM:SS, up to 23:59:59).
                                                     A run that reaches the limit reports what it measured up to then.
                                                     Each run of --count or --loop gets the limit afresh, and --delay is not counted. [default: 00:10:00]
  --csv                                              Display output as a single CSV row (always includes timestamp).
  --no-csv-header                                    Do not write the header row (CSV output only).
                                                     An appended --file target that already holds rows is never sent the header.
  --json                                             Display output in Json format.
  --json-pretty                                      Display output in Json format (pretty print).
  --minimal                                          Display the result as a single timestamped line per run.
                                                     Ideal for watching repeated runs with --loop or --count.
  --simple                                           Display the result as one named line per figure: Ping, Download, Upload.
                                                     Ideal for batch scripts and line-based parsing.
  --no-latency                                       Do not perform latency test.
